units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:10">Bets. II, 10</cite> <he>ע׳ של קטן</he> children’s wagon.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 5:4">Sabb. V, 4</cite> <he>בע׳ שתחת וכ׳</he> with the little wagon under the tail (to protect the latter from friction, v. <cite ref="H01170"><he>חֲמַט</he> II</cite>); a. e.—Pl. <he>עֲגָלוֹת</he>.
Kel. XXIV, 2 שלש ע׳ הן וכ׳ there are three classes of wagons (with regard to levitical cleanness), one shaped like a cathedra; like a couch …, and one for stones (loads).
Gen. R. s. 95; a. e.—Esp. עֲגָלָה the constellation called Charles’ Wain (Ursa Major).
